reuse.why: Changes only the shared getScheduledAmount, which every consumer (api, forecast, schedules app, schedule templates, SchedulesTable) already calls, and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified in its single definition.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case rule already lives.

scope.why: Focused on the rule and its tests, though the call-site comments that still say 'end furthest from zero' (forecast-schedules.ts, schedules/app.ts, shared/schedules.ts) were left stale.

maintainability.why: Math.min / amount minus threshold is a clearer expression of 'lowest value' than the previous code, in one place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: None; the change edits the existing shared abstraction.
